scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c blue,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @weddingos/database generate && pnpm --filter @weddingos/api build && pnpm --filter @weddingos/worker build && next build --webpack
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @weddingos/contracts build && pnpm run verify:marketing-capabilities:built && pnpm --filter @weddingos/config build && pnpm --filter @weddingos/jobs build && pnpm --filter @weddingos/database generate && pnpm --filter @weddingos/database build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests scripts docs/adr docs/*.md '*.{json,js,mjs,ts,yml,yaml,md}'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests scripts docs/adr docs/*.md '*.{json,js,mjs,ts,yml,yaml,md}'
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm --filter @weddingos/api test && pnpm --filter @weddingos/worker test
scripts.test:integration: env WEDDINGOS_RESET_ISOLATED_DATABASE=true pnpm db:test:prepare:integration && env DATABASE_PURPOSE=integration pnpm --filter @weddingos/api test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: env WEDDINGOS_RESET_ISOLATED_DATABASE=true pnpm db:test:prepare:e2e && pnpm --filter @weddingos/api build && pnpm --filter @weddingos/worker build && playwright test
scripts.db:test:prepare:integration: pnpm run build:packages && node scripts/prepare-isolated-database.mjs integration
scripts.db:test:prepare:e2e: pnpm run build:packages && node scripts/prepare-isolated-database.mjs e2e
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm build
